newsitem.title: GERMANY: Intel jumps in Frankfurt after Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Intel jumps in Frankfurt after Q3 results.

text.p: Shares of U.S. computer company Intel Corp trading on the Frankfurt bourse leaped over ten percent after the company reported a 40 percent rise in third quarter profits on Monday after the Wall Street close.
Intel shares in Frankfurt reached a new year high of 177.50 marks, gaining 16.20 marks, before falling back to stand at 177.10 marks.
The Intel results, powered by strong sales of its Pentium and Pentium Pro processors, surpassed even the most optimistic estimates on Wall Street, according to analysts
Traders said Intel shares rose 7-3/8 to $115 in after-hours U.s. trading following the release of the third quarter results. Intel shares had closed up 2-1/4 at $107-5/8.
